title: SealedSetCommitment
description: The L3 commitment of one sealed team set (evaluation protocol L3, I2; ADR-010 erratum E1): hashes and counts only. set_commitment is SHA-256(JCS({salt, teams})) with a random salt and key_commitment the SHA-256 of the secret seed key; neither the teams, the salt nor the key appear. The reader checks the counts against the parameters (the total, n_stratum_min in each stratum, b_sealed) and that the strata are sorted and unique.

set_id.description: The set's name in the register.

generation.description: Which generation of sealed sets this is.

set_commitment.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of {salt, teams}.

key_commitment.description: SHA-256 of the secret seed key.

team_count.description: Number of sealed teams; the parameters' n_teams.

stratum_counts.description: Teams per stratum cell, sorted by stratum and unique (a reader rule); logged with the commitment (erratum E1).

stratum.description: A stratum label tuple, as the merge rule produced it.

evaluation_parameters_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the EvaluationParameters record in force.

training_gate_rule_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the TrainingGateRule record in force.

b_sealed.description: Runs this set allows; the parameters' b_sealed.
